name: sunset-lake-blonde-cinematic-portrait
image_purpose: show a polished lakeside fashion moment with natural atmosphere

prompt.project_info: Ultra-detailed cinematic portrait of an approved generic adult woman by a tranquil lake at sunset.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult blonde woman with long wavy hair, bright eyes, natural skin texture, and minimal elegant makeup. She wears a clean white cropped hoodie with realistic cotton folds and coordinated white leggings. Pose is relaxed and confident, with one hand near her hair and natural proportions.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm sunset rim light on hair and face balanced by cool blue-hour shadows, subtle backlight, serene cinematic nature mood, realistic reflection on the lake.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic full-frame DSLR or mirrorless look, 85mm lens, f/1.8, shallow natural depth of field, rich dynamic range, refined color grading.
